query: Run a dry registry rebuild and inspect the active skill list.
expected_behavior: PixelBoats project skills (pixelboats-adaptive-audio, pixelboats-p0-stabilization, etc.) appear in active list
Mirror roots under projects/<slug>/.ai/skills/ are noted but NOT in active list unless canonical
--dry-run returns status=0 with 'dry run' display and no file write unless --apply is passed
failure_signs: PixelBoats skills missing from active list despite canonical path existing
projects/<slug>/.ai/skills/ entries appear in active list
Registry JSON is overwritten without --apply or --backup warning
